omission_reason: Original execution-environment-specific launch and GO contents are not part of the portable public source copy. Exact original GO hashes remain in the unchanged runtime and external dependency manifests. Authorized consumers need their own original pinned inputs; omitted bytes are not reconstructed or accepted as sanitized authority.

reviewed_resource_profile.origin: Exact original reviewed receipt recovered byte-for-byte from its retained emitted generated-run JSON and canonical writer; SHA256 equals the immutable review pin.
reviewed_resource_profile.later_additional_profile: A later generated-only rerun is retained privately as additional evidence and is not substituted for the review-bound receipt in this packet.

upstream_reference_path_classification.handling: Exact public upstream bytes retained without silent source edits; no such operational path is used by this offline binding.
